name: Lidify
description: Lidify is a music discovery tool for Lidarr. It reads your existing Lidarr artists and uses Last.fm, Spotify or MusicBrainz to suggest similar artists, which can then be added straight back into Lidarr from the web UI.

notes.text: Configure the Lidarr address and API key, and a Last.fm or Spotify API key, under Settings in the web UI on first run.
Lidify lets environment variables override config/settings_config.json. A Lidify setting added to /opt/lidify/.env wins over the web UI, and changes made there will appear to revert.
